name: infomaniak-ai
description: Connect your Infomaniak accounts and discover your services. Start read-only, with your token in the app's private settings.
long_description: An independent, unofficial connection for Infomaniak. Enter your API token in the extension settings, then ask: Show my Infomaniak services. If you have several accounts, you choose which one to inspect. This desktop edition starts with read-only account and product discovery. No server hosting is required. Your token is used locally to call Infomaniak; returned service information is shared with your AI client. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Infomaniak.

api_token.title: Connect Infomaniak
api_token.description: Paste your Infomaniak API token here, not in chat. Use the accounts scope and only the product permissions you need. Your first connection is read-only.
